preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance the preserved bootstrap into a human-scale grounded locomotion blockout with authoritative walk, sprint, crouch, jump, airborne, and landing behavior plus a collision-backed route ending at a placeholder Alpha interaction volume, while keeping the intentionally rough 20×16 m room and all verified bootstrap behavior intact.

diagnosis.root_cause: The verified candidate intentionally stops at the prototype-bootstrap depth: it has a correctly scaled CharacterBody3D capsule, floor contact, WASD movement, mouse look, collision-backed room, and deterministic F6 reset, but its controller exposes only one ground speed and gravity. It has no jump, sprint, crouch, stance/locomotion authority, matching input actions, or placeholder Alpha interaction volume. This is a missing locomotion increment, not evidence that the preserved bootstrap is defective.

stop_conditions: Stop and repair before handoff if the project no longer boots cleanly or emits script/resource errors.
Stop and repair if physical F6 no longer restores position (0,0.9,5.4), zero velocity, zero yaw/pitch, and captured input, or if physical R begins invoking restart.

Stop and repair if ordinary movement can fall through or escape the room, penetrate the route barrier, jump while airborne, stand into an obstruction, or leave the camera/capsule at inconsistent crouch heights.
Do not import the production map, weapons/hands, HUD, minimap, enemies, production props, or decorative packs; those surfaces remain outside this blockout increment.

Do not implement or claim the deferred authoritative Alpha enter/leave/complete trace or integrated locomotion review in this task; leave the volume structurally ready for their later backlog validation.
After developer-side source checks and focused runtime probes pass, stop and hand off; GameLoop Runtime and QA Tester own fresh recapture, formal verdicts, gap closure, and phase closure.

strategy.rationale: Retain the already verified room, player hierarchy, dimensions, camera framing, input capture, mouse look, collision, and reset path. Add locomotion as explicit state derived from input, floor state, stance, and vertical velocity; adapt capsule and camera together for crouch; expose compact runtime state for deterministic inspection; and minimally extend the existing blockout into a traversable route with an Alpha volume. This directly closes the selected grounding gap without pulling in the deferred objective transition or later production assets.

code: Parse/load project.godot, main.tscn, and scripts/prototype_player.gd and verify all new input actions, node paths, exported properties, and state fields resolve without errors.
Run the frozen clean_boot check and preserve prototype_bootstrap_boot_shell, prototype_bootstrap_input_camera, and prototype_bootstrap_review behavior.
Inspect the InputMap to confirm movement plus jump/sprint/crouch keyboard and gamepad bindings are present, restart remains exclusively physical F6, and physical R is not assigned to restart.

Inspect scene structure to confirm the standing player dimensions, Head/Camera3D hierarchy, collision-backed room/route geometry, and Alpha Area3D/CollisionShape3D binding are present without production asset dependencies.
runtime: From a fresh run, record a baseline digest at spawn showing position (0,0.9,5.4), on_floor=true, standing stance, zero velocity, current camera, and captured input.

Using ordinary input on the same straight floor segment, sample walk, sprint, and crouch movement for matched durations; confirm distinct authoritative modes and sprint distance greater than walk distance greater than crouch distance.
Trigger one grounded jump and sample jump start, airborne ascent/descent, landing, and restored floor contact; attempt a second jump while airborne and confirm no extra launch occurs.

Enter crouch while stationary and while moving, verify the camera and collision height lower together without changing the foot datum, then release under blocked clearance and after returning to clear space to prove stand-up rejection and restoration respectively if a clearance fixture is provided by the blockout route; otherwise verify the controller's clearance predicate directly and its clear-！
visual: Capture the shipped gameplay camera at spawn to confirm preserved neutral exposure, human-scale eye height, and asymmetric cyan/amber orientation cues without HUD, weapons, or production assets.

Capture one representative route frame near the collision-backed obstacle while grounded and one frame approaching the identifiable Alpha placeholder; confirm the route is readable, bounded, and traversable without void, fall-through, proxy overlap, or camera clipping.

Capture a crouched route frame and a post-landing grounded frame to verify coherent camera height, floor contact, and stable framing. These are sparse grounding views only; formal Alpha transition recapture remains deferred to its backlog check.

done_when: Physical WASD and equivalent configured movement input remain camera-yaw-relative, accelerate and decelerate predictably, and move the approximately 1.8 m capsule without floor penetration, wall escape, or barrier tunneling.

Walk, sprint, and crouch have authoritative, inspectable modes with clearly ordered travel rates: sprint is faster than walk and crouch is slower than walk; sprint cannot remain active while crouched or airborne.

Jump begins only from a valid grounded state, produces upward velocity, transitions through airborne state, returns to grounded/land state without repeated mid-air jumps, and maintains stable floor contact after landing.

Crouch input lowers both collision height and camera/eye presentation together, preserves the capsule's grounded foot datum, supports crouched movement, and refuses to stand when head clearance is blocked; releasing crouch when clear restores the original standing dimensions and camera height.

The existing blockout contains a simple collision-backed start-to-Alpha route using only deliberate proxy geometry. A visibly identifiable placeholder Alpha Area3D with a real CollisionShape3D exists at the route endpoint and is reachable by ordinary locomotion without teleportation; authoritative enter/leave/complete behavior remains deferred.

The player's diagnostic state exposes position, velocity, on-floor status, locomotion mode, stance, current target speed, and relevant jump/landing state so runtime evidence can distinguish walk, sprint, crouch, airborne, and grounded outcomes.

The preserved 20×16 m bounded room, neutral exposure, asymmetric cyan/amber orientation cues, CharacterBody3D/Head/Camera3D hierarchy, spawn transform, 75° FOV, 82° pitch clamp, captured-input startup, physical F6 reset behavior, and absence of later-phase production content remain intact.
Godot source/resource validation and clean boot pass with no new script, resource, debugger, or runtime errors.
tasks.instructions: Extend the existing player controller rather than replacing its verified hierarchy or reset path. Add explicit movement/stance authority for idle, walk, sprint, crouch, jump, airborne, and landing using CharacterBody3D floor state and vertical velocity. Configure ordinary keyboard and equivalent gamepad actions for jump, sprint, and crouch while preserving WASD, mouse look, F6 restart, and the reload-reserved physical R key. Keep standing capsule and eye height within the already credible human-scale datum; when crouching, change collision and camera presentation coherently and perform a real clearance check before standing. Use grounded-only jump initiation, gravity while airborne, stable landing/floor snapping as appropriate, and mutually consistent sprint/crouch rules. Extend _mcp_state with compact authoritative locomotion fields for host inspection. In the existing scene, use only intentional primitive blockout geometry to make a short readable route around or through collision-backed cover and place a clearly identifiable placeholder Alpha Area3D with a matching CollisionShape3D at its endpoint. Do not add objective completion authority in this iteration because objective tracing is a deferred backlog gap. Preserve the current room, spawn, camera, lighting/orientation cues, and all bootstrap constraints; do not acquire or preload production assets.
tasks.title: Implement grounded human-scale locomotion and Alpha route blockout
